types.name: Attribute
types.description: A typed attribute defined by the merchant and attached to a product or product family.

fields.name: description
fields.description: An optional description of what the attribute represents.

fields.description: The human-readable label shown for the attribute.

fields.description: The unique identifier of the attribute's definition.

fields.description: The attribute's machine name, unique within the account.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The data type of the attribute's value.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The attribute's value, resolved to the typed JSON form for its `type` — read `type` to know the shape. E.g. SHORT_TEXT → a string, WEIGHT → { value, unit }, MONEY → { amount, currency }. Null if unset. See AttributeType for each type's shape.

types.name: AttributeType
types.description: The data type of a merchant-defined attribute. Determines the JSON shape of the attribute's `value` (documented on each enum value).

values.name: COLOR
values.description: A color. `value` is a string, e.g. a hex code "#FF0000".

values.name: DATE
values.description: A calendar date. `value` is a "YYYY-MM-DD" string, e.g. "2026-01-15".

values.name: DATETIME
values.description: An instant. `value` is an ISO-8601 UTC string, e.g. "2026-01-15T09:30:00Z".

values.name: DIMENSION
values.description: A length. `value` is an object `{ value, unit }`, e.g. { "value": 30, "unit": "cm" }.

values.name: ENUM
values.description: A single choice from a defined set. `value` is the chosen option as a string.

values.name: FLOAT
values.description: A decimal number. `value` is a number, e.g. 3.14.

values.name: INTEGER
values.description: A whole number. `value` is a decimal string (to preserve precision), e.g. "42".

values.name: JSON
values.description: Arbitrary JSON. `value` is returned as-is (object, array, or scalar).

values.name: LINK
values.description: A hyperlink. `value` is an object `{ text, url }`.

values.name: LIST_SHORT_TEXT
values.description: A list of short strings. `value` is an array of strings, e.g. ["S", "M", "L"].

values.name: LONG_TEXT
values.description: Multi-line plain text. `value` is a string.

values.name: MONEY
values.description: A monetary amount. `value` is an object `{ amount, currency }`, e.g. { "amount": 19.99, "currency": "USD" }.

values.name: RICH_TEXT
values.description: Rich text. `value` is a string of HTML/markup.

values.name: SHORT_TEXT
values.description: Single-line text. `value` is a string, e.g. "Cotton".

values.name: VOLUME
values.description: A volume. `value` is an object `{ value, unit }`.

values.name: WEIGHT
values.description: A weight. `value` is an object `{ value, unit }`, e.g. { "value": 1.5, "unit": "kg" }.
